findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected (spec D-2/D-7): a worker failure affects the mounted table; leaving and starting a new table gets a fresh worker. Actual: the app-wide client enters its failed state permanently, so after any worker error or messageerror every later table in the session fails its first bot step until the page is reloaded. Recovery is out of scope (REQ-056), so not blocking.
findings.fix: When REQ-056 recovery lands, let the shared client be replaced after it fails (e.g. sharedAdviceClient recreates a client whose worker has failed), or note the reload requirement in that story.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected (spec §5): useTableSession's createAdviceWorker option creates that table's worker. Actual: the option is ignored whenever the app-wide client already exists (always in the app and harnesses), so it is a near-dead seam and leaving a table no longer stops an in-flight computation (the orphan reply is still computed and dropped; a new table's first request queues behind it).
findings.fix: Record in the spec/story that the seam only applies before the shared client exists, or remove it in a later story; no behaviour change required now.

summary: All 15 SPEC items PASS. Vitest 488/0, lint/typecheck clean, e2e 114 pass/6 skip, e2e:slow 8 pass/2 skip, locked paused-clock e2e 50/50 serial, playtest 10k clean, SPEC-10 bundle check clean. Judge holdouts: worker==headless on 60 judge hands, no hidden info or replay code in any posted message (unit and real app), stale replies never apply, hostile service inputs never throw, real app responsive with a slowed production worker and safe Leave-table mid-decision. SPEC-15 kills the main-thread mutant. D-2 deviation accepted on substance; two LOW findings, no blocking findings.
